jobs.description: Overview: At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What We're Looking For: As a Principal Software Engineer at Zebra, you will act as a key technical leader and full-stack developer, shaping the future of our enterprise device and cloud solutions. Under consultative direction, you will be entrusted to determine and pursue courses of action essential to achieving our predetermined long-range targets. This is a hands-on, full-stack software engineering leadership role, not a DevOps or IT infrastructure position. We are seeking a master-level engineer who will personally research, architect, design, and write production-grade code for our most complex and real-time cloud solutions. You will also maintain the critical software for our products and systems, acting as a technical leader who builds and delivers enterprise-grade platforms from the ground up. A key aspect of your work will involve performing complex system integration of software and hardware to ensure program consistency and maintain system throughput. Beyond coding, you will develop, validate, and test system structures and user documentation to ensure we deliver robust, high-quality, and well-documented solutions. Candidates whose experience is primarily in DevOps, SRE, or cloud administration will not be considered for this position. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: • Architects, designs, and oversees the development of cloud software solutions for highly complex technical projects, ensuring alignment with business and technical strategies and highly decoupled microservices optimized for distributed cloud environments. • Creates detailed software specifications and leads the technology roadmap process, recommending project approaches and long-term goals • Champions innovation and cultivates creativity among team members, fostering an environment that attracts and retains top talent • Leads and advises on all aspects of the software development lifecycle, prioritizing quality and continuous improvement • Monitors competitor products and development strategies, ensuring the organization’s designs exceed industry standards • Develops next-generation technologies and solutions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines, anticipating and addressing client needs before the competition • Protects intellectual property by analyzing competitor patents and contributing to related organizational initiatives • Serves as a thought leader, representing the organization as a spokesperson on specialized projects and programs • Establishes formal networks and coordinates efforts across teams and organizational units to achieve shared objectives • Acts as a prime consultant and advisor for projects impacting the organization’s long-term technical and business goals • Provides strategic mentorship to senior engineers and management, fostering knowledge sharing and technical excellence • Lead end-to-end development of high-performance cloud solutions, ensuring maximum reliability and system uptime. • Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud-native products. • Build low-latency, real-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals. • Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance. Job Requirements: • Bachelors Degree or Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline • 10+ years of relevant full stack development experience with a Bachelors Degree or 7+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree • Expert hands-on experience in architecture, design, full-stack development, and coding is essential. Experience limited to DevOps will not qualify for this position. Key Skills and Competencies: • Expertise in software architecture, system design, and scalable software solutions for enterprise-level applications • In-depth knowledge of multiple programming languages, advanced software development methodologies, and adopting GenAI in the Software Development Lifecycle • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and drive complex, high impact projects to completion • Strong strategic thinking skills, with a focus on long-term technical and business goals • Exceptional innovation and creativity in solving complex challenges and developing novel solutions • Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop technical talent, fostering a culture of learning and growth • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience engaging with senior leadership and external customers • Familiarity with intellectual property protection, competitor analysis, and industry trends • Proven hands-on experience of 10+ years as a Cloud Solutions Engineer with multiple enterprise-grade solutions architected, designed, developed, and delivered. • Proven hands-on experience in architecting and developing highly scalable, multi-tenanted, and real-time solutions. • Proven hands-on experience with microservice architecture, design, and development. • Proven hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes. • Proven hands-on experience with real-time push notifications for mobile devices and peripherals. • Extensive hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and others. • Expertise in designing and managing highly scalable databases such as PostgreSQL, BigQuery, and MongoDB. • Excellent problem-solving skills, the ability to troubleshoot complex issues, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment. • Strong programming skills in languages such as JavaScript and Java. • Solid understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, and cloud architecture patterns. • GCP Platform Deployment: Leverage Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services to design, deploy, and continuously optimize cloud-native products. • Real-Time Systems: Build low-latency, real-time push notification and messaging systems for enterprise mobile devices and peripherals. • Data & Database Systems: Manage and tune highly scalable databases and storage layers (PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) to guarantee data integrity and performance. • Data Analytics Integration: Seamlessly integrate analytics and telemetry pipelines into cloud platforms to extract actionable system insights. • AI Integration in SDLC Adaptation: Drive the secure adoption of AI technologies (such as Claude and other LLMs) within the software development life cycle (SDL), ensuring code quality, security compliance, and prompt engineering best practices. • Leadership & Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical specs, and mentor junior engineers to drive continuous improvement. • Documentation & Stakeholder Reporting: Maintain comprehensive architectural designs and proactively report on project milestones, risks, and systems health. Position Specific Information: • Travel Requirements: Up to 15% • Able to Telework?: Hybrid Physical Demands: • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting or standing Benefits: We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. Job Posting Statement: To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. AI Technology Statement: Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy. jobs.title: Java Software Engineer - Connectors - Remote
jobs.description:
Company Description
 

   Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.


 For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.



   Job Description
 

   Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?


 About the Team


 The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations.


 Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.


 Key team values:


 
  Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
  Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
  Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
  Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead
 
 About the Job


 As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.


 Key Responsibilities:


 
  
   Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.


  
   Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.


  
   Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).


  
   Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.


  
   Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.


  
   Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.


  
   Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.


  
   Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.


 
 About You


 You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.


 

   You will be successful in this role if you:


 
  
   Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.


  
   Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.


  
   Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.


  
   Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.


  
   Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.


  
   Are able to make data-driven decisions.


  
   Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.


  
   Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.


 

   Qualifications
 

   We are looking for:


 
  
   7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.


  
   5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.


  
   Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.


  
   Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.


  
   Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.


  
   Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.


  
   Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).


 
 

   Technical Skills and Experience:


 
  
   Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).


  
   Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).


  
   Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.


  
   Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.


  
   Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.


  
   Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.


  
   CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).


  
   OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).


  
   Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).


 

   Additional Information
 
What You’ll Get:


 
  Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
  Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes.
  Career development and mentorship
  A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart
 
  Please be advised that Jitterbit does not:


 
  Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms.
  Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact.
  Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process.
  Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages.
 
 #LI-AK1


 
 Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionalsDistributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production supportMentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growthInnovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay aheadAbout the Job
As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities
Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.
Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.
Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).
Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.
Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.
Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.
Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.
Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.
About You
You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.
You will be successful in this role if you:


Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.
Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.
Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.
Are able to make data-driven decisions.
Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.
Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.
QualificationsWe are looking for
7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.
5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.
Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.
Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.
Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience
Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).
Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).
Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.
Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.
Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.
Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.
CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).
Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).
